summary: Completed comprehensive mobile optimization testing for French web app 'Stratégie & Expertise Santé'. Tested on 3 mobile viewports: 375px (iPhone), 320px (smallest), 412px (Android Samsung). All critical mobile features working correctly: responsive hero section, mobile menu with opaque background, StrategiIA modal, ChatBot full-screen mode, Dossier Express banner, Mascotte mobile widget, Alerte Urgente button/modal, Footer partner form, and floating elements positioning.

issues: ChatBot bubble text can temporarily intercept clicks on Alerte Urgente button until dismissed - minor UX friction but not blocking

test_credentials: No auth needed for mobile testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile optimization fully tested. Key findings: 1) No horizontal overflow on any viewport (320px, 375px, 412px). 2) All inputs have 16px font-size (prevents iOS zoom). 3) ChatBot goes full-screen on mobile (inset-0). 4) StrategiIA modal uses dvh for max-height, fits viewport. 5) Mobile menu has opaque background (rgb(10,10,8)). 6) Mascotte desktop widget hidden on mobile, mobile widget renders in-flow. 7) Floating elements (ChatBot FAB, Alerte Urgente) don't overlap. 8) Footer partner form single-column on mobile. 9) Safe-area-inset-bottom applied to floating elements.
